name: usepsyc1
label: Will take medicine because personal trouble

questions.text:
How likely would you be to take doctor-prescribed psychiatric medication in the following situations? 
A. ...because you were having trouble in your personal life.
questions.stem: How likely would you be to take doctor-prescribed psychiatric medication in the following situations?
questions.item: A. ...because you were having trouble in your personal life.

questions.item: B. ...because you didn't know how to cope anymore with the stresses of life.

name: psyckid1
label: Will give kid med because kid is hostile

questions.text:
How likely would you be to give doctor-prescribed psychiatric medication to your child or a child you were responsible for in the following situations (A child would be considered anyone between the ages of 8 and 15). 
A....because s/he is hostile, often loses his/her temper, often argues with adults, actively defies authority and seems spiteful or vindictive.

name: psyckid2
label: Will give kid med because school trouble

questions.text:
How likely would you be to give doctor-prescribed psychiatric medication to your child or a child you were responsible for in the following situations (A child would be considered anyone between the ages of 8 and 15). 
B...because s/he is not paying attention at school, does not follow through with school work and chores, has difficulty organizing activities, is easily distracted, talks excessively, and seems to run around or fidget constantly.

name: psyckid3
label: Will give kid med because kid talked suicide

questions.text:
How likely would you be to give doctor-prescribed psychiatric medication to your child or a child you were responsible for in the following situations (A child would be considered anyone between the ages of 8 and 15). 
C....because s/he was talking about killing him or herself.
